name: dsh-connector-adapter
description: Lets a DSH sign in to another DSH's dsh-agent-connector through DSH's stock MCP client, with normal OAuth.
//dependencies: dsh-connector-shared (the DSH side's library) carries ./live-settings, the re-apply of this row on a live settings change that dsh-connector-adapter and dsh-connector-watchdog both use. It is bundled, as dsh-agent-connector bundles it, so the tarball installs with no registry fetch for it.
//devDependencies: Test-only: the adapter's tests speak the connector's published MCP and OAuth contract (dsh-agent-connector/mcp-schema) to their fake connector, and use the shared test helpers. Neither ships.
